Hi Sarah,

Unbelievable. To be blunt, this is completely amateurish and unacceptable.

First, I was told the unit was reserved. Then I was told it had been released from your Rotterdam warehouse and was "on its way." Now, a week later, you admit nobody even checked the physical bin, and it wasn’t in stock at all? You have literally been lying and making promises you didn't bother to verify, while I am left waiting yet again.

This is exactly the type of terrible service and excuses I was worried about from the start. HeliumDeploy has zero control over inventory and zero respect for customers' time.

I expect you to get this shipped from the US warehouse today, and I want the tracking number provided immediately. No more excuses, no more empty promises.

---
Mvh / regards
Raymond H.

Hi Sarah,

A $25 discount code requiring me to spend another $100 with HeliumDeploy is a total insult. Given the endless delays, false information, and terrible customer service I have experienced time and time again, what on earth makes you think I would ever spend another dollar in your shop? Keep the code.

I don't want more excuses or useless discount codes. Since you failed to deliver from Europe as promised and wasted an entire week of my time, I expect you to send the unit from Chattanooga using Express Shipping today at your expense.

Send me the Express tracking number the moment the package is dispatched.

---
Mvh / regards
Raymond H.
